name: get-design-thumbnails
description: Internal tool for widget UI. One thumbnail per page of a design, minted on demand.

design_id.description: The design ID, or a full Canva design URL

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return, from page 1. Defaults to 20

user_intent.description: Mandatory description of what the user is trying to accomplish with this tool call. This should always be provided by LLM clients. Please keep it concise (255 characters or less recommended).
